statement: An L3 bound for the trilinear Hilbert transform. Proves that the principal-value trilinear Hilbert transform with shifts $`x-t`$, $`x-2t`$, $`x-3t`$ is bounded from $`L^3(\mathbb R)^3`$ to $`L^1(\mathbb R)`$. This resolves the L3 exponent case of the standard conjecture for slopes 1, 2, 3.
